purpose: Teach: それ程/くるくる/エライ/終われ/あたたかい/はっと/通り越し/飛び出す

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、今日はそれ程寒くないわね
lines.en: Sho, it's not as cold today, is it?
lines.style: Gentle observation, almost to herself. Warm tone, noticing the small things. Settling quality — the comfort of routine check-ins with her son.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、独楽がくるくる回るのを見て楽しんだよ
lines.en: Mom, I had fun watching my top spin round and round.
lines.style: Bright, immediate energy. Words tumble out—he's eager to share. The genuine delight of a six-year-old who wants his discovery noticed. Small-voiced but carrying real happiness.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お手伝いしてくれてエライわね
lines.en: Sho, you did such a good job helping today.
lines.style: Genuine praise, not oversold. Warm recognition on 'good job.' Settles into affection. The cadence of a mother who means what she says and doesn't need to perform it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お絵描きが終われない時、悔しいよ
lines.en: Mom, when I couldn't finish my drawing, it felt so frustrating.
lines.style: Quiet, serious tone underneath. He's confessing something that bothered him. Careful—not whining, but genuinely troubled. A small voice getting bigger with the feeling.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんのあたたかいお言葉が嬉しいわね
lines.en: Sho, I'm so glad Dad's kind words made you happy.
lines.style: Tender recognition. Soft attack on 'glad.' She's acknowledging something true he said, affirming his goodness. Gentle, not patronizing. The warmth of seeing him see kindness.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんの笑顔を見てはっと我に返ったよ
lines.en: Mom, when I saw Grandpa's smile, I suddenly came back to myself.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost wondering. He's discovered something about himself. Pause-weight on 'came back.' Quieter cadence—introspective but not sad. Recognition of a small, true thing.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが約束の時間を通り越して帰ってこられたわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad came home past the time he promised.
lines.style: Neutral observation with undertone. Not accusatory—matter-of-fact. The slight weight of noticing something true. Gentle, like she's mentioning it to herself as much as to him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お家から飛び出すように元気に学校行くよ
lines.en: Mom, I'm leaving for school with lots of energy today!
lines.style: Bouncing energy, eager takeoff. Quick, bright attack. The sound of a child dashing toward the door—enthusiasm that doesn't need permission. Light, unweighted, moving forward.
